Non-Oxford British English standard spelling of commonize.

examples.text: “The trick is not to commonise the wrong bits in different models. You commonise parts such as batteries and alternators, not things the customer can see, like the window switches.”

Special new fasteners are being introduced on the new car to hold it together better than ever. To simplify design and ease of maintenance I eventually hope to commonise and standardise all fasteners on the car.
He attempted to commonize the various standards by ensuring a similar format and implementation.

glosses: To deprecate the importance of, or make ordinary.

examples.text: She gave each participant a trophy, regardless of win or loss, to commonize the award for winning.

Towards the end of August, the Southern Railway decided to adopt a novel form of publicity to popularise the services. Sandwich board men were employed at Charing Cross and Cannon Street to display placards, and distribute leaflet timetables, calling attention to the vacant seats on the services via Nunhead.
Special cheap day return facilities have been introduced to popularise the railbuses.

glosses: To present information in a form less difficult for the general public to understand or enjoy, especially by excluding details and jargon found in technical or academic publications.
American and Oxford British spelling of popularise

examples.text: Saudi yoga trainer Dr. Nouf Marwaai has also been honored with one of India’s highest civilian awards, the Padma Shri, for popularizing yoga.
Das Virus verbreitet sich in der ganzen Population.
Der Duft nach Rosmarin verbreitete sich im ganzen Haus.
„Seit unsere sich Welt zunehmend vernetzt, verbreiten sich auch vermehrt Pilze rund um den Globus.“
Der Missionar verbreitet den christlichen Glauben gegen den Willen der Einheimischen.
„Mit ihrem Sprung am Gummiseil war das Bungee-Jumping in Neuseeland geboren und verbreitete sich wie ein Lauffeuer auf der ganzen Welt.“
Der Wind verbreitete die Löwenzahnsamen über die gesamte Kiesfläche.
Der Bürgermeister verbreitete sich in aller Genüsslichkeit über den Gesetzesentwurf der Opposition.
